messages:
Dana: Heads up 1 - two customers hit a search crash post-launch when queries include long emoji sequences. Need quick call on next micro-sprint tradeoffs.
Erik: Summary: tokenizer chokes on "emoji+zwj" clusters. Repro steps in the ticket.
Maya: UX team also filed 2 small polish items (result spacing + keyboard focus) that are low-effort.
Sanjay: Crash is P0 for affected customers. Root cause looks like an unhandled surrogate pair edge-case in the tokenizer.
Erik: Fix paths: 1) emergency input-sanitizer in the parser (~1 dev-day, low risk) OR 2) full tokenizer refactor (~2 dev-weeks, better long term).
PM-Liz: Customers want a timeline. We should mitigate now and plan the refactor later unless we decide to postpone other work.
Dana: My vote: mitigate now, ship sanitizer on canary, monitor for 48h, then schedule full refactor in the next iteration if needed.
SQE: Acceptance criteria for sanitizer: no crashes on the corpus and <0.1% error rate on sampled queries. Also add regression test with the two customer examples.
Maya: If we're doing a mitigation, can we sneak in the two UI polishes into the same micro-sprint? They're each ~4h.
Sanjay: We can, but only if we keep the refactor off the current sprint. Band-aid + 8h of UX is doable.
Erik: Dev ETA: sanitizer PR in 24h, QA run 12h, canary rollout next day. Refactor to be scoped and estimated separately.
PM-Liz: I'll log a follow-up milestone: "tokenizer-refactor-3.0" with owner Erik, estimate 10d. Also adding label: "followon:refactor".
Dana: Backlog action: move the two UI polishes to the current sprint dev column, tag them "quickwins".
Maya: Added. Tickets: SEARCH-892 (spacing), SEARCH-893 (keyboard focus).
Erik: Opening branch: `emergency/sanitize-emoji-input`. Link: https://github.com/redwood/search/pull/456 (WIP).
InfraBot: Canary window requested: 2024-06-10T05:00Z for service "search-query". Auto-rollbacks enabled.
SQE: Running smoke now once PR lands. Will post test matrix and logs.
SQE: Smoke pass. Added unit tests for surrogate pairs. Running load tests to ensure no perf hit.
SQE: Load passes. No regressed p50/p95 beyond 5%.
Maya: Since quickwins merged, UX looks better in canary. Thx.
Erik: Canary observed for 24h, crash count at 0 for those signals. Moving to production in 2h if no surprises.
PM-Liz: I'll prepare a customer note: mitigation done, full tokenizer refactor planned (link to milestone).
Dana: Decision recap: emergency sanitizer + two UX quickwins in this micro-sprint. Refactor scheduled as follow-on milestone. Owners: Erik (dev), SQE (tests), Maya (UX), PM-Liz (comms).
Sanjay: I'll update the SLA risk doc and flag the refactor as a dependency for larger multi-language support.
Erik: PR merged -> canary -> prod rollout started.
InfraBot: Production rollout started at 2024-06-11T08:15Z. Monitoring channels: #prod-alerts.
Dana: Thanks team. Closing thread; keeping tokenizer-refactor on top of backlog for next planning session. :tada:
